<div class="wrapper">
<div class="container">
<div class="inner">
<h1>CTE Financial Support FAQ</h1>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<picture>
<source srcset="https://www.mcsf.org/wp-content/themes/mcsf/assets/images/american-flag.jpg" media="(min-width:992px)" class="image_bg">
<img class="image_bg_mobile" src="https://www.mcsf.org/wp-content/themes/mcsf/assets/images/american-flag.jpg" alt="">

<span class="bg_image" style="background-position: center center"></span>
</section>
<section id="" class="default_text section_spacing bg_gray_light">
<div class="container">
<div class="inner clearfix fade_up_in">
<p>This FAQ page answers common questions about our Career and Technical Education program. For questions relating to our primary application program as well as more detailed information about required documents for the application please visit <a href="https://www.mcsf.org/apply/scholarship-faqs/">https://www.mcsf.org/apply/scholarship-faqs/</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="faqs" class="faqs section_spacing">
<div class="container">
<div class="inner">
<div class="faq_categories categories">
<ul class="clearfix">
<li>
<a href="#general" class="active">General</a>
</li>                        
<li>
<a href="#eligibility" class="active">ELIGIBILITY</a>
</li>                        
<li>
<a href="#application" class="active">APPLICATION</a>
</li>                        
<li>
<a href="#after_your_award" class="active">AFTER YOUR AWARD</a>
</li>                        
</ul>
</div>
<div id="general" class="faq_section">
<h3>General</h3>
<div class="faqs">
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>What does CTE stand for?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>CTE is the abbreviation for Career & Technical Education.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>What is financial support for CTE?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>The Marine Corps Scholarship Foundation provides financial support to those students who meet need-based eligibility to further their education. Awards are not required to be repaid, and they can be combined with other financial supports you may receive.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="eligibility" class="faq_section">
<h3>ELIGIBILITY</h3>
<div class="faqs">
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>I’d like to attend career training or trade school for a non-degree certificate program. Am I eligible?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>Yes! Our Career & Technical Education (CTE) program provides financial support to students planning to attend a non-degree certificate program or vocational training of any length at a school eligible for federal funding and listed on <a href="https://nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator">https://nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>What are the eligibility requirements for the CTE application?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>In short, all applicants must be the child of a Marine or a Navy Corpsman, Chaplain or Religious Programs specialist attached to a Marine unit, have a cumulative unweighted GPA of 2.00, and have an adjusted gross income at or below the financial eligibility threshold determined by the Foundation on an annual basis.</p>
<p>For more information about eligibility requirements, visit <a href="http://www.mcsf.org/eligibility">www.mcsf.org/eligibility</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>What programs are considered CTE?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>In addition to traditional vocational trades such as heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), plumbing, and cosmetology, CTE also encompasses programs in the agriculture, construction, A/V Tech, education, hospitality, and many other fields. For more detailed information about what may be considered a CTE program, visit <a href="https://careertech.org/what-we-do/career-clusters/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://careertech.org/what-we-do/career-clusters/</a> .</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>I am pursuing a degree-granting program. Am I eligible?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>Our CTE program is limited to non-degree certificate programs or vocational training. However, our undergraduate scholarship application is open from January 1 to March 1 each year and can be accessed at <a href="https://www.mcsf.org/apply/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://www.mcsf.org/apply/</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>Is this a competitive program?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>No, we award to all who qualify! All eligible applicants must submit complete applications with all correct documentation.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>I am not a recent high school graduate. Am I still eligible to apply?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>This program has no age requirement. We welcome applicants regardless of age or educational journey.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>I already have a degree, but I am interested in a professional certificate program to further/advance my career, can I still apply? </p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p><span class="TextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8" lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8">No,</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8"> i</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8">f you’ve already earned</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8"> </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8">a</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8"> bachelor’s degree</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8"> </span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8">or completed all of your undergraduate courses, then </span></span><span class="TrackChangeTextInsertion TrackedChange SCXW74013951 BCX8"><span class="TextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8" lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8">you are ineligible</span></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8" lang="EN-US" xml:lang="EN-US" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8"> for</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8"> this program</span><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW74013951 BCX8">.</span></span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="application" class="faq_section">
<h3>APPLICATION</h3>
<div class="faqs">
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>How much financial support is awarded to each student?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>Financial support awards are $2,500, $5,000, $7,500, or $10,000 per academic year. Award amounts are based on factors including financial need, GPA, and available funding. The awards are renewable for up to four paid awards if your program is longer than one year, but you are required to re-apply and meet our eligibility criteria each year.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>How do I know when to apply for CTE financial support?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>The CTE application is available all year, and applications are processed on a monthly basis. We encourage you to submit your application approximately two months prior to your program start date to account for the processing period.</p>
<p>Below is an example of the application timeline:</p>
<ul>
<li>Week 1 – Complete and submit an application</li>
<li>Week 2-6 – Application reviewed and processed</li>
<li>Week 7 – Decision e-mail sent</li>
<li>Week 8 – Recipient completes Acceptance Package for payment disbursement to school</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="after_your_award" class="faq_section">
<h3>AFTER YOUR AWARD</h3>
<div class="faqs">
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>Can my award be used to pay for school-related costs beyond tuition? </p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>Yes, awards can be used towards the total cost of attendance, as determined by your school or program. Cost of attendance can include but is not limited to: tuition/fees, room/board, supplies and books, transportation, and other school-related expenses as defined by your school. You should discuss directly with your school’s Financial Aid Office about their reimbursement/disbursement policies and how you wish to use your awarded funds.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>Can I use funds from this program to pay towards the cost of an apprenticeship program?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>Yes, if the apprenticeship program is administered through an accredited institution. For a list of accredited institutions, visit <a href="https://nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">College Navigator</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="faq">
<div class="question">
<p>What schools can I attend?</p>
<span class="arrow">
<i class="fas fa-chevron-right"></i>
</span>
</div>
<div class="answer">
<p>We will send your award to any school eligible for federal funding and listed on <a href="https://nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://nces.ed.gov/collegenavigator</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
